items.title: Warren Buffett’s Coca-Cola Shares Now Pay Back Two-Thirds of What He Paid, Every Single Year
items.summary: Warren Buffett, 96, says Coke and McDonald's keep him going, and Coca-Cola pays Berkshire $848 million a year on 400 million shares bought for $1.3 billion between 1988 and 1994. Here is what that dividend math says for a 72-year-old widow with $1.6 million who inherited 4,000 Coke shares and is being told to buy more for the income.
